name: krmrn-skills
description: A community-friendly marketplace of Claude Code skills and plugins — opinionated, evidence-based, and progressively-disclosed. Contributions welcome.

plugins.name: skill-linting
plugins.description: Hard structural lint for Claude Code skills. Zero-deps Python script (scripts/lint.py) reports tier-1 errors (frontmatter validity, name/description length caps, name format, parent-dir match, body line cap, manifest version-sync, plugin registration) and tier-2 warnings (third-person heuristic, exclusion clause, reference TOC threshold, reference depth, orphan references). Three output formats: human, GitHub Actions annotations, json. Honors per-line noqa comments and a .skill-lint.toml config for repo-wide and per-skill disables (with a reason convention). Slash command /skill-linting:lint, Makefile target make lint-skills, pre-commit hook. Not for general markdown linting, code formatting, or content review.

plugins.name: chat-search
plugins.description: Cross-project full-text search across local Claude Code conversations. Maintains its own SQLite FTS5 index at $XDG_DATA_HOME/krmrn42-skills/chat-search/index.db, refreshed lazily from ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl. Three surfaces: TUI picker by default on a TTY (Enter resume, Ctrl-F fork, Ctrl-R rename, Ctrl-P pin, Ctrl-T remote-control, Ctrl-W tmux-window inside $TMUX, Alt-Enter dangerous when armed, ? help overlay), one-shot CLI for piping (`multivac <query> --list` / `--format tsv`), and `/chat-search:find` inline rendering. Saved names + pins persist in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/krmrn42-skills/chat-search/sessions.json and propagate as `claude --name`. Zero external deps — one Node script using node:sqlite (Node 22.5+); no fzf, no Python. `/chat-search:setup` symlinks `bin/multivac` into ~/.local/bin; also installable as `npm install -g @krmrn42/multivac && multivac init`. Flags: `--regex`, `--scan`, `--project`, `--since`, `--limit`, `--reindex`, `--index-status`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `--print-names`, `--unpin-all`, `--no-tmux`. See MANUAL.md for the user guide. Trigger on "find that chat where I figured out X", "search history for Y".

plugins.name: prdspec
plugins.description: Implements the Requirements Management Framework end-to-end — PM exploration → Pitch (PRD) → Epics → User Stories → tracker push, optimized for AI-agent-driven delivery and PLG. Four user-invoked slash commands — /prd (PRD synthesis with exploration snapshotting and gap-protocol questions), /epics (epic shaping in explore-vs-direct modes with explicit inherited-PRD pointers), /stories (story decomposition with ripgrep-driven implementer context and pinned project-knowledge anchors), /push (tracker-agnostic mirroring with flag registration; reads tracker + flag-platform from the host project's AGENTS.md). Three templates (PRD/Epic/Story) and six conventions (frontmatter, gap-protocol, no-fabrication, parent-chain, flag-naming, workspace-layout). Tool-agnostic runbooks bound to the filesystem backend via tools.md — MCP migration path is a single-file rewrite. Trigger phrases: 'write a PRD', 'shape epics for', 'decompose this epic into stories', 'push this epic to the tracker', 'mirror to Jira/Linear/GitHub Projects', 'draft a pitch'. Not for: brainstorming product strategy from scratch (use after PM exploration converges), tracker administration, or general project documentation.
